evals.prompt: Set up kodit in a fresh Git project. The project is called 'taskflow', a TypeScript CLI tool. Build with 'npm run build', test with 'npm test'. Main branch is 'main', dev is 'develop', feature prefix is 'feat/', bugfix prefix is 'fix/'. Labels should include the defaults plus 'blocked' and 'priority'.
evals.expected_output: kodit.json written with correct fields. AGENTS.md, README.md, and CONTEXT.md created with marker-delimited managed blocks. No unresolved placeholders. Git-null handling not triggered. All three documents render the configured branches and labels.
expectations: Creates AGENTS.md with <!-- kodit:agents:v1:start --> and <!-- kodit:agents:v1:end --> markers
Creates README.md with <!-- kodit:readme:v1:start --> and <!-- kodit:readme:v1:end --> markers
Creates CONTEXT.md with <!-- kodit:context:v1:start --> and <!-- kodit:context:v1:end --> markers
AGENTS.md contains the correct six-phase sequence with implement (not implement-loop)
README.md contains project.description from the metadata
CONTEXT.md renders branches as main / develop / feat/ / fix/
Labels in AGENTS.md include all seven configured labels (five defaults plus blocked and priority)
No unresolved {{...}} placeholders in any output file
kodit.json has version 1, correct project fields, and git section with configured values

evals.prompt: Set up kodit in a fresh project that does not use version control. The project is called 'notepad', a Python script. No build or test commands. Issue tracking should use the file-based backend at .kodit/issues.
evals.expected_output: kodit.json written with git: null. AGENTS.md, README.md, and CONTEXT.md created. Branch paragraphs say 'Not configured' or are omitted. No branch placeholders in any output.
expectations: kodit.json has git set to null
AGENTS.md contains 'Version control is not configured' instead of branch placeholders
README.md omits the branch sentence (no branch paragraph present)
CONTEXT.md renders Branches as 'Not configured'
CONTEXT.md has only one initial decision row (adoption), not two (no branch model row)
No {{git.main_branch}} or similar placeholders remain in any output
Tracker fields render as file at .kodit/issues

evals.prompt: Append a kodit section to an existing README.md that already has a custom '## My Notes' section with project-specific content. The README has no prior kodit content and no legacy sections. Project is 'webapp', a Go service.
evals.expected_output: The existing README.md content is preserved. A new managed block is appended at the end. The custom '## My Notes' section is byte-preserved.
expectations: README.md contains the original '## My Notes' section unchanged
A new <!-- kodit:readme:v1:start --> block is appended after existing content
The managed block contains project description from kodit.json
No existing content was deleted or reordered
The file plan shows 'append (managed block)' for README.md

evals.prompt: The project has AGENTS.md with a legacy '## kodit Workflow' section (no markers) that matches the old template output exactly. Set up kodit and detect the legacy section. Offer migration.
evals.expected_output: Legacy section is detected. A migration diff is shown in the checkpoint. After approval, the legacy section is replaced with the current managed block. Other content is preserved.
expectations: Legacy '## kodit Workflow' section is detected without markers
Migration mode is triggered with a bounded before/after diff
After approval, the legacy section is replaced with <!-- kodit:agents:v1:start/end --> managed block
Content outside the legacy section boundaries is preserved
The file plan shows 'migrate' for AGENTS.md
The new managed block contains the correct six-phase sequence with implement (not implement-loop)

evals.prompt: Re-run kodit setup on a project where all three documents already have current managed blocks (<!-- kodit:agents:v1:start -->, etc.). The project is 'demo', a Rust library.
evals.expected_output: All three documents report no-op. No files are modified. The checkpoint shows 'already up to date' for each managed document.
expectations: AGENTS.md action is no-op
README.md action is no-op
CONTEXT.md action is no-op
No bytes were changed in any of the three documents
The final summary reports no files modified for the three managed documents
